ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. The sentence ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub says where a cup is. Where is it? (1 mark)
   A. At the door
   B. In the bag
   C. Under the bed
   D. On the table

2. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا أَبِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my mother.
   B. My father works.
   C. This is my father.
   D. I have a brother and a sister.

3. Which Arabic word means "open the door"? (1 mark)
   A. قِفْ
   B. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   C. أَغْمِضْ عَيْنَيْكَ
   D. اُخْرُجْ

4. What is meant by listening for the gist? (1 mark)
   A. Writing every word you hear
   B. Listening for the main idea
   C. Listening only for names
   D. Repeating everything loudly

5. What does the Arabic sentence اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I am a pupil (girl).
   B. My name is Ahmad.
   C. I am from Kenya.
   D. I am a pupil (boy).

6. Which Arabic word means "bread"? (1 mark)
   A. خُبْزٌ
   B. طَمَاطِمُ
   C. تُفَّاحٌ
   D. سُكَّرٌ

7. What does the Arabic sentence هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Blessed festival (Happy Eid).
   B. Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   C. Happy birthday.
   D. May you be well every year.

8. What is the theme of a text? (1 mark)
   A. Its main topic
   B. Its number of lines
   C. Its size
   D. Its colour

9. Which Arabic word means "tooth"? (1 mark)
   A. وَجْهٌ
   B. سِنٌّ
   C. رَأْسٌ
   D. أُذُنٌ

10. Which Arabic sentence means "My sister is beautiful." (1 mark)
   A. مَرْحَبًا يَا أَحْمَدُ
   B. جَدِّي كَبِيرٌ
   C. أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ
   D. أَخِي صَغِيرٌ

11. What does the Arabic sentence أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I like juice.
   B. I visit my grandmother on Friday.
   C. I read a book on Sunday.
   D. I help my mother on Saturday.

12. What does the Arabic sentence الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ mean? (1 mark)
   A. The water is clean.
   B. The weather is hot.
   C. The weather is cold.
   D. The weather is rainy.

13. Which Arabic word means "and upon you peace (the reply)"? (1 mark)
   A. كَيْفَ حَالُكَ؟
   B. أَنَا بِخَيْرٍ
   C. مَرْحَبًا
   D. وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ

14. What does the Arabic word عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) mean? (1 mark)
   A. eye
   B. hair
   C. hand
   D. tongue

15. What does the Arabic word رِيحٌ (riih) mean? (1 mark)
   A. wind
   B. beautiful
   C. environment
   D. cold

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. Translate into English: haadhaa abii (2 marks)

17. Translate into English: haadhihi ghurfatii (2 marks)

18. Write three Arabic questions about a picture of a party and give their meanings. (3 marks) (3 marks)

19. Translate into English: aqraʾu kitaaban yawma l-ahad (2 marks)

20. Translate into English: ar-riihu qawiyya (2 marks)

21. Translate into English: marhaban yaa Ahmad (2 marks)

22. Translate into English: haadhihi shams (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #15 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — On the table
   ʿalaa t-taawilati kuub means 'on the table there is a cup'.

2. C — This is my father.
   هَذَا أَبِي (haadhaa abii) means: This is my father.

3. B — افْتَحِ الْبَابَ
   افْتَحِ الْبَابَ (iftahi l-baab) means open the door.

4. B — Listening for the main idea
   The gist is the main idea. You do not need to understand every word.

5. B — My name is Ahmad.
   اسْمِي أَحْمَدُ (ismii Ahmad) means: My name is Ahmad.

6. A — خُبْزٌ
   خُبْزٌ (khubz) means bread.

7. B — Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   هَلْ عِنْدَكَ حَفْلَةٌ؟ (hal ʿindaka hafla?) means: Do you have a party? (to a boy)

8. A — Its main topic
   The theme is the main subject of the text.

9. B — سِنٌّ
   سِنٌّ (sinn) means tooth.

10. C — أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ
   أُخْتِي جَمِيلَةٌ (ukhtii jamiila) means: My sister is beautiful.

11. D — I help my mother on Saturday.
   أُسَاعِدُ أُمِّي يَوْمَ السَّبْتِ (usaaʿidu ummii yawma s-sabt) means: I help my mother on Saturday.

12. A — The water is clean.
   الْمَاءُ نَظِيفٌ (al-maa'u nadhiif) means: The water is clean.

13. D — وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ
   وَعَلَيْكُمُ السَّلَامُ (wa ʿalaykumu s-salaam) means and upon you peace (the reply).

14. A — eye
   عَيْنٌ (ʿayn) means eye.

15. A — wind
   رِيحٌ (riih) means wind.

SECTION B
----
16. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my father.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

17. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is my room.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

18. (3 marks)
   Answer: For example ayna l-kaʿka? (Where is the cake?) man haadhaa? (Who is this?) maadhaa fawqa t-taawila? (What is above the table?)
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct question with meaning.

19. (2 marks)
   Answer: I read a book on Sunday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

20. (2 marks)
   Answer: The wind is strong.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

21. (2 marks)
   Answer: Hello, Ahmad.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: This is the sun.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.
